# Forward Air Announces Two-Year Definitive Agreement to Retain Significant Portion of Previously Disclosed Customer Relationship


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_fc2b12de7201d273ad45ede874461a5d/forwardair/news/2026-10-28_Forward_Air_Announces_Two_Year_Definitive_420.pdf) October 28, 2026


*2026 to 2028 Forecasted Annual Revenue from Customer Expected to* *Exceed 2025 Revenue Driven by Growth in Retained Services*


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Forward Air Corporation (NASDAQ: FWRD) (the “Company,” “Forward,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement (“the Agreement”) with one of its largest customers (the “Customer”) under which the Customer has agreed to continue utilizing the Company for a significant portion of the services currently provided for a two-year term. The Agreement also provides for the orderly transition of certain services currently provided to the Customer, which is expected to occur between November 2026 and March 2027. The transition is not expected to materially impact Forward’s revenue in 2026.


The revenue from the retained services that the Company provides the Customer has continued to grow throughout 2026 and is expected to continue growing in 2027. The Company expects annual revenue in each contract year of 2026, 2027 and 2028 (the contract period) to exceed the Customer’s total revenue contribution in 2025.


Shawn Stewart, President & Chief Executive Officer, said, “We are pleased to finalize this Agreement and believe it reflects the strength of our longstanding 20-year partnership and the exceptional service our team continues to provide. By signing this Agreement, we should bring both greater visibility and predictability to our business and the associated profitability and resulting cash flow.”


**About Forward Air Corporation**


Forward Air is a leading asset-light provider of transportation services across the United States, Canada and Latin America. We provide expedited less-than-truckload services, including local pick-up and delivery, shipment consolidation/deconsolidation, warehousing, and customs brokerage by utilizing a comprehensive national network of terminals. In addition, we offer truckload brokerage services, including dedicated fleet services, and intermodal, first and last-mile, high-value drayage services, both to and from seaports and railheads, dedicated contract and Container Freight Station warehouse and handling services. Forward also operates a full portfolio of multimodal solutions, both domestically and internationally, via Omni Logistics. Omni Logistics is a global provider of air, ocean and ground services for mission-critical freight. We are more than a transportation company. Forward is a single resource for your shipping needs. For more information, visit our website at[www.forwardaircorp.com](http://www.forwardaircorp.com/) .
